title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
summary: Claude in Chrome extension is now generally available on all paid Claude plans, enabling direct website interaction without integrations using existing credentials. The extension includes auto-approval for safe actions via a safety classifier and reports 0% prompt-injection attack success against Claude Sonnet 5/Opus 5 models, signaling improved security for enterprise automation.

title: A guide to the anatomy of effective commerce agents
summary: Anthropic released an open-source commerce agents blueprint with reference implementations for consumer- and merchant-facing agents across retail, travel, telecom, and ticketing. Testing showed single agents with modular skills outperformed subagent designs on quality, cost, and latency, with emphasis on safety via code, persistent memory, and evaluation frameworks for financial transactions.

title: Building commerce agents with Claude
summary: Anthropic's commerce agents blueprint includes reference implementations for Messages API, Agent SDK, and Claude Managed Agents, compatible with Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, and Google Cloud Vertex AI. Partners like Shopify and Priceline report 35% larger shopping carts and 60% higher purchase completion rates.

title: How an Anthropic field marketer uses Claude Code to send weekly personalized updates to every sales rep
summary: An Anthropic field marketer automated weekly sales briefings using Claude Code to pull data from BigQuery, CRM, and Slack into personalized Slack digests per sales rep. Scaling across multiple teams, the automated system nearly doubled event registrations by surfacing opportunities to the right people.

title: Claude for Teachers, now available for U.S. K-12 schools and districts
summary: Claude for Teachers expands to a free Enterprise offering for schools and districts with centrally managed organizations, SSO, and role-based access controls. New teaching skills for lesson preparation and check-for-understanding (math-focused at launch) join FERPA-compliant data protection, with a full year free for schools signing up by June 30, 2027.

title: Claude gets its own browser in Cowork
summary: Claude Cowork now includes a built-in browser isolated from users' personal browsers—Claude cannot access personal tabs, bookmarks, or credentials unless explicitly imported. Rolling out to Pro, Max, and Team this week with prompt-injection safeguards, while Claude in Chrome handles collaborative web work and shared pages.
